EUROPEAN BASKETBALL COMES TO LONDON! 🇪🇺🦁 We’re proud to announce the launch of the London Lions Invitational, a brand-new pre-season tournament bringing some of European basketball’s most storied clubs to the capital. Taking place at the Copper Box Arena on 10–11 September, we’ll be joined by: 🇱🇹 Žalgiris Kaunas 🇫🇷 Paris Basketball 🇵🇱 Śląsk Wrocław A level of visiting club competition rarely seen on UK shores. The tournament tips off on Thursday 10 September, with London facing Śląsk Wrocław at 5:30 PM, followed by Žalgiris vs Paris at 8:30 PM. The action concludes on Friday with the third-place game at 5:30 PM and the final at 8:30 PM. The Invitational builds on our sold-out pre-season meeting with Žalgiris last season, while renewing our rivalry with Paris — who ended our EuroCup run at the Semi-Final stage in 2024 before going on to lift the trophy. 📍 Copper Box Arena 📅 10–11 September 🎟️ Tickets on sale now from £19.
